title: Wordmark anatomy
slide_intent: Explain the specific choices inside a custom wordmark because distinctiveness depends on details that should survive refinement.
strategic_value: Wing-inspired features, broad proportions and short ascenders can connect Duolingo’s lettering to its mascot while keeping the name readable.
demonstration: Six annotations surround a large green wordmark, identifying the wing-inspired ascender, circular low-contrast forms, short ascenders, wing-tipped stem junction, wide proportions and eyebrow-inspired g.
practical_value: Use annotated anatomy to distinguish meaningful signature features from incidental drawing choices.

content_islands.name: Wordmark specimen
content_islands.spec: Stretch the green signature across the center of the pale field.

content_islands.name: Feature annotations
content_islands.spec: Keep each handwritten note with its dotted circle or alignment marker above or below the relevant letters.

reference_purposes.Intent: The printed annotations explicitly connect the d ascender and g flick to Duo; accompanying agency prose explains the aim of expressing the brand’s personality.
reference_purposes.Expression: The diagram identifies six characteristic formal choices in the signature.

ingredient.name: Feather Bold and the Duolingo wordmark
ingredient.application: Preserve the identified wing features, broad proportions and rounded forms when assessing the signature.
ingredient.scope: Historical 2019 case-study evidence. These are observed design relationships, not a license to redraw the mark or a complete type-usage specification.
